FULL TEXT:
STENOGRPHER RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION 2025
NOTICE
No.- 35/R&A Dated: 22nd May, 2026
All the candidates of Stenographer Recruitment Examination, 2025 (notified under
Advertisement No. PHC/02/2025) are hereby informed that the scores of the Computer Based
Written Test comprising English Shorthand Computer Typing Test, Multiple Choice Question
based Objective Test and English Computer Typing Test held on 22.12.2025 as well as
Interview held on 10.03.2026-12.03.2026, 18.03.2026-19.03.2026 and 30.03.2026-31.03.2026
respectively have been made available on the website of the Court. The candidates may view
their scores by clicking on the link given on Court’s website using their login credentials
provided to them at the time of registration.
The candidates must take notice that the link shall remain active till 30.06.2026 only.
Besides, in light of Clause 12(xxix) of the above-referred advertisement, no application
under RTI seeking information relating to scores and cut-off marks of the Stenographer
Recruitment Examination, 2025 shall be entertained.
By order of the Court
Sd/-
Registrar General I/c
